scope: CPU comparison of the periodic ternary free-energy and chemical-potential kernel against a local evaluation of CudaPhaseField formulae. No upstream CUDA execution or multiphase flow acceptance.

lambda_consistency.metric: Relative error in each lambda and the harmonic mean for the equal-tension case

laplacian_operator.metric: Mean absolute relative error on the analytic Laplacian check

gradient_operator.metric: Maximum absolute relative error on each analytic gradient component

chemical_potential_planar.metric: All components finite and maximum absolute first-component chemical potential below the limit

chemical_potential_pointwise.metric: Relative error for each component against the local reference formula

droplet_equilibrium.metric: Chemical potentials finite and standard deviation of the first-component chemical potential inside the initialized droplet below the limit

nonuniform_sigma.metric: Absolute error in each lambda and harmonic mean for the unequal-tension case

full_field_comparison.metric: Maximum relative error in each chemical-potential component over the 24 by 24 field against the local reference formula
